title: Viral Title
description: One in a million: celebrating the customers shaping AI’s future. Did you know, just 0.0001% of AI users are propelling 80% of the industry's innovation? These are the power users, the early adopters, and the innovators who are not just consuming technology but shaping its very trajectory. This podcast explores the incredible range of AI advancements, including the groundbreaking 72-core Grace CPU from NVIDIA. This episode also delves into the future outlook of AI for 2026 and discusses the significant role these elite users play in solving large-scale problems in genomics, climate modeling, and autonomous driving.
